Morocco long boy is beautiful!! ❤️  Morocco is geographically bounded by the Atlantic Ocean to the west, the Mediterranean Sea to the north, and Algeria to the east and southeast. Its northernmost tip sits just 13 kilometres across the Strait of Gibraltar from Europe, where it shares unique, fortified land borders with Spain via the tiny North African autonomous enclaves of Ceuta and Melilla. To the south, Morocco borders the disputed territory of Western Sahara, which it largely controls and administers, extending down toward the border with Mauritania. Because of long-standing political tensions, the extensive desert land border between Morocco and Algeria remains completely closed, making the country's international land transits highly restricted despite its strategic position at the crossroads of Europe and Africa. #maps #geography #border #morocco #africa
